acceptance: default (zstd) tsbs_devops load into InfluxDB gives dbgen row counts
default port consistent between metadata and compose
context: Priority medium: fails loudly, with a workaround (--compression none). Not fixed by the verifier.
description:
Found by live verification of #3952 on origin/develop 525361b2f8, influxdb:3-core.

Reproduction: `benchbox run --platform influxdb:core --benchmark tsbs_devops --scale 0.01 --phases generate,load --platform-option host=localhost --platform-option port=8181 --platform-option ssl=false --non-interactive` (default compression zstd gives cpu.csv.zst etc.).
Expected: cpu 172800, mem 172800, disk 345600, net 345600 rows.
Actual: `Required benchbox tables are missing or empty after load: no rows were loaded for any table. Loaded tables: []` because InfluxDBAdapter.load_data looks only for data_dir/<table>.csv (benchbox/platforms/influxdb/adapter.py, around line 135) and skips the .csv.zst files. With `--compression none` the same load gives exact row counts (see item perf-questdb-influxdb-load-20261030 evidence). Also, the default port in platform metadata is 8086 while the compose stack and adapter default_service_port use 8181, so `--platform-option port=8181` is required. Pre-existing since the initial release (csv_path line dates from e0438e9932).

Suspected: InfluxDBAdapter.load_data should resolve files through normalize_table_paths / the compression handler like other adapters.
